issue.detail: Spec does not define q before first negedge or during reset before any clock edge; contract reset.first_released_cycle and update_during_reset=true leave initial q ambiguous.
issue.alternative: q holds unknown/X until first negedge; reset only takes effect at negedge.

issue.detail: Spec does not state whether reset is synchronous or asynchronous; contract asserts sync, but S01 only says synchronous reset, which is consistent, yet no explicit clock-edge qualification for reset in spec text.
issue.alternative: reset is asynchronous active high, overriding q immediately.
